cands.name: Ed Markey
cands.desc: Senator since 2013 (House 1976-2013); runs on progressive record, climate policy and co-authoring the Green New Deal.

cands.name: John Deaton
cands.desc: Marine veteran and trial attorney (2024 GOP nominee); backs congressional term limits, a ban on lawmaker stock trading, and lowering costs.

cands.name: Maura Healey
cands.desc: Governor since 2023, former attorney general; endorsed by the Massachusetts AFL-CIO and Planned Parenthood Advocacy Fund of MA.

cands.name: Mike Minogue
cands.desc: West Point graduate and Army veteran, former chairman and CEO of medical-device maker Abiomed; founder of MedTechVets.
